reviews.body:
Appreciate that you split the Mistral half out of #3081 and tested the legacy side too: 7B, Mixtral and both 2402 models still score 1.0 on head. I ran the new tests on base and head, then called `relevance()` through the provider against Bedrock on both, and 14 of the 15 Mistral ids I tried score 1.0 on head. The one that doesn't is `mistral.mistral-large-2407-v1:0`.

Large 2407 takes the `prompt` body but answers in the chat shape (`choices`, `usage`), so while it sits in `_MISTRAL_LEGACY_PREFIXES` the `outputs[0]` read raises `TypeError`, same as on base. Without that entry it sends `messages` and scores 1.0, which matches the InvokeModel example on AWS's [Mistral Large (24.07) page](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock/latest/userguide/model-parameters-mistral-large-2407.html). Pixtral Large replies to `prompt` the same way and isn't in the list, so this PR also fixes its `us.` and `eu.` profiles, which could go in the description. Both suggestions are inline.

| `relevance()`, retries 0, us-east-1 unless noted | base 4014d75 | head 45349d9 |
|---|---|---|
| `mistral.mistral-large-3-675b-instruct` | ValidationException: missing field `messages` | 1.0 |
| `mistral.ministral-3-8b-instruct` | same ValidationException | 1.0 |
| `mistral.magistral-small-2509` | same ValidationException | 1.0 |
| `us.mistral.pixtral-large-2502-v1:0` | TypeError, reply has `choices` | 1.0 |
| `eu.mistral.pixtral-large-2502-v1:0` (eu-west-1) | TypeError, reply has `choices` | 1.0 |
| `mistral.mistral-large-2407-v1:0` (us-west-2) | TypeError, reply has `choices` | same TypeError; 1.0 with the suggestion |
| `mistral.mistral-large-2402-v1:0` | 1.0 | 1.0 |
| `amazon.nova-lite-v1:0` | 1.0 | 1.0 |

Head also scores 1.0 on Ministral 3 3B and 14B, Devstral 2, and Voxtral Mini and Small.

```
base + new test file     3 failed, 46 passed   TypeError: 'NoneType' object is not subscriptable
head                     49 passed (with test_bedrock_capabilities.py and test_bedrock_nova_serialization.py)
head + both suggestions  51 passed, ruff 0.16.3 check and format clean
```
Thanks for keeping mistral model usage up to date on bedrock!

review_comments.body:
`mistral.mistral-large-2407-v1:0` accepts the `prompt` body but replies with `choices`, so this entry sends it to the `outputs[0]` read (`TypeError` in us-west-2 on base and head). With the line removed it sends `messages` and scores 1.0.
```suggestion
```

This pins 2407: it fails until the `_MISTRAL_LEGACY_PREFIXES` entry is dropped (1 failed, then 51 passed with both changes). `list-inference-profiles` shows no Magistral profile in the nine regions I checked; Pixtral Large is the Mistral model with `us.`/`eu.` profiles, and it was broken on base too.
```suggestion
        "mistral.magistral-small-2509",
        "mistral.mistral-large-2407-v1:0",
        "us.mistral.pixtral-large-2502-v1:0",
```
